sections.ingredients:
Intuppu (Rock salt) 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum ammi) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 

 Method of preparation 
 Take the ingredients in its provided amount, rock salt up to 10 grams, pippali up to 40 grams, haritaki up to 60 grams and ajamoda up to 20 grams. 
 Roast the rock salt on low flame. 
 Grinded all the ingredients separately, mixed properly and your Intuppukana Churna is ready.
sections.dose: One to three grams with hot water or sour buttermilk, one or two times a day, after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Over dose can cause gastric irritation. 
 Avoid in hypertension.

fullContent:
Intuppukana Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Sahasra Yoga, Churna prakarana, 23. 
 Introduction 
 Intuppukana Churna is an herbal formulation. This consists of mixture of herbs. This is also known as intuppukana churnam. The intuppu, also known as rock salt, known for its coolant properties. This is known to treat the problems of digestion. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Intuppu (Rock salt) 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum ammi) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 Take the ingredients in its provided amount, rock salt up to 10 grams, pippali up to 40 grams, haritaki up to 60 grams and ajamoda up to 20 grams. 
 Roast the rock salt on low flame. 
 Grinded all the ingredients separately, mixed properly and your Intuppukana Churna is ready. 
 Dose 
 One to three grams with hot water or sour buttermilk, one or two times a day, after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Digestion power 
 Malabsorption 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dose can cause gastric irritation. 
 Avoid in hypertension. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
